latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Editor For — AI-powered video editing and export tool.

- Instantly edit and export videos with plain-language instructions—no manual timeline work required.
- Automatic onboarding: obtains and stores an anonymous API token if needed, then sets up a background session.
- Upload raw footage and specify edits (e.g., cut pauses, add background music); results delivered as 1080p video in 1–2 minutes.
- Supports key actions: video export, credits check, status updates, file upload, and instant edit requests—all matched via intent classification.
- Real-time cloud GPU rendering pipeline, with automatic error handling and simple retry or help prompts for common issues.
- Track edits and timeline state; receive concise updates and download links without leaving the chat.
